decisions.formal_equilibrium_release_approval: defer-for-evidence; no protected/external holdout, no waiver

claim_ledger.claim: The frozen census covers all 34 observed substantive expansion reports, two per KNOW01-KNOW17, with no substantive root gap and no scored parent/child duplication.
claim_ledger.source_truth_status: Historical rendered-source population only; original-export equivalence and unseen history remain unknown.
claim_ledger.preservation_status: Source boundary accepted for the scoped calculation.
claim_ledger.consequence: A missing root range or doublecount would invalidate the denominator.
claim_ledger.next_test: Keep this exact census hash. Reopen and version the census only on supported new source evidence, with before/after results.

claim_ledger.claim: On the final manifest, all 2413 admitted parent blocks are preserved under protocol 2.1, yielding 2413/2413 = 100% of the frozen observed-expansion source-block proxy; package-weight sensitivity is 3121/3121 = 100%.
claim_ledger.source_truth_status: The source propositions remain historical unverified assertions, analysis, proposals and citation leads.
claim_ledger.preservation_status: Full for all 2413 admitted parents under the declared rubric; partial 0, missing 0, disputed-fidelity 0, ungraded 0.
claim_ledger.consequence: An unqualified 100% label could be mistaken for total Project meaning, current truth or general task quality.
claim_ledger.next_test: Report the exact boundary, numerator/denominator and historical status beside the figures. Rerun affected fidelity and usability checks after a frozen component changes.

claim_ledger.claim: The packet permits the authorized maintainer to retrieve, compare and reconcile useful historical research without the source account in the selected reader tasks.
claim_ledger.source_truth_status: No current company fact or linked-source support is confirmed by reader-task success.
claim_ledger.preservation_status: Supported for the defined historical maintenance job and tested tasks, with no surviving discovered usability defect.
claim_ledger.consequence: Generalizing purposive tasks into all-user success or a population error rate would exceed the evidence.
claim_ledger.next_test: Keep the job-specific wording. A broader usability or outcome claim needs an appropriate independent evaluation design.

claim_ledger.claim: The final packet retains the checked table relationships, metadata delimiters/indentation and observed citation associations after versioned repairs without changing the frozen source denominator.
claim_ledger.source_truth_status: Observed leads and unresolved citation markers are preserved without being promoted as valid support.
claim_ledger.preservation_status: Three table-view defects and one bounded literal-metadata display defect were repaired and rechecked; no surviving defect was identified.
claim_ledger.consequence: Exact stored strings alone can conceal reader-facing structure loss.
claim_ledger.next_test: After generator or formatting changes, repeat literal delimiter/indentation, all repaired cell/marker/link checks, and full records/link checks.

claim_ledger.claim: The scoped 100% result demonstrates greater than 60% or the preferred greater than 80% of total Project reusable value retained.
claim_ledger.source_truth_status: Whole-Project denominator and unobserved original contents are unknown.
claim_ledger.preservation_status: No whole-Project percentage or finite retained-value lower bound is demonstrated.
claim_ledger.consequence: Substituting the expansion boundary would falsely declare the owners broader objective complete and could encourage source loss.
claim_ledger.next_test: Recover original payload bytes or a supported export, reconcile identity and unique useful contents, bound the whole-Project denominator, then recalculate under an explicit value measure.

claim_ledger.claim: Historical preservation credit requires current factual verification of every source assertion first.
claim_ledger.source_truth_status: Historical truth/currency remains unverified and separate from fidelity.
claim_ledger.preservation_status: A disputed or unverified historical proposition can be fully preserved. Only disputed preservation fidelity/usability loses conservative credit.
claim_ledger.consequence: Conflating truth with retention would erase historical value, replace details with warnings and misstate the rubric.
claim_ledger.next_test: No current-fact check is needed for faithful historical credit. Run issue-specific primary-source review only before current-answer use or factual promotion.

claim_ledger.claim: The packet and review establish tested model behavior, a product runtime, deployment, publication/rights clearance or owner acceptance.
claim_ledger.preservation_status: Draft recovery and static file review do not supply these outcomes.
claim_ledger.consequence: A reader could rely on an unimplemented or untested surface or infer consent and clearance.
claim_ledger.next_test: Use the separate implementation, evaluation, rights and owner-acceptance workflows only when such claims are proposed.

claim_ledger.claim: A passing retention figure authorizes archiving any of the 26 source chats.
claim_ledger.source_truth_status: The current owner hold forbids source archiving; no reviewer performed an archive action.
claim_ledger.preservation_status: All 26 source records remain held regardless of any scoped score.
claim_ledger.consequence: Archiving could violate the owners instruction and impair recovery of still-unbounded value.
claim_ledger.next_test: Maintain the hold. A new direct owner instruction is required to change archive authority; this review supplies none.

claim_ledger.claim: All required inputs for an unrestricted formal Equilibrium release approval are present.
claim_ledger.source_truth_status: No protected or external holdout is supplied; reviewer-selected tasks were exposed during repair.
claim_ledger.preservation_status: This does not negate exhaustive observed arithmetic or completion of authorized draft recovery.
claim_ledger.consequence: Calling this a fully satisfied formal release gate would silently waive a required skill input.
claim_ledger.next_test: If formal Equilibrium release approval is later sought, supply a valid protected or external holdout tied to the final artifact and preserve its selection, isolation, execution and adjudication record. No waiver is claimed.

claim_ledger.claim: The public draft and source ledger correctly keep the whole-Project target unknown and source archiving held while identifying the final frozen packet.
claim_ledger.source_truth_status: This checks preservation/scope wording and version references, not all ancillary prompt, baseline-corpus or factual claims in the wider harvest.
claim_ledger.preservation_status: Final manifest and census references match. Public review statuses and released_percent remain intentionally pending in the reviewed pre-adjudication snapshots.
claim_ledger.consequence: A stale pending label or overbroad final label could obscure what this adjudication decided.
claim_ledger.next_test: Update status wording to report completed analytical adjudication and the supported deterministic figures, while preserving formal release deferral, whole_project_percent null and all holds.

independence: Separate contexts using the same model family and overlapping captured evidence. No protected/external holdout or independent current-fact corroboration.
final_consistency: All68 output/record hashes,34 root partitions,2902 retained blocks,2413 admitted weights and4743 adjacent-link records checked with0 mismatches.
remaining_dependency: Original payload bytes or supported export for identity and unique-content reconciliation.
source_evidence_status: Historical unverified research; no current-fact or product behavior approval
